# Essaypad / 에세이패드

> A free, ad-free local essay and writing-project word-progress tracker with
> no account and no subscription. Add an essay, set a target word count and
> an optional deadline, write anywhere else, then enter the new total here.
> Progress bar, percentage, words to go, and a daily target computed from
> the remaining words and the write days left (all days or weekdays only).
> Back-dated updates, per-day calendar history, several essays, JSON backup.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://essaypad.try-dabble.com/
Essays, their per-day history and the write-days setting stay in this browser
on this device. No accounts, no sign-in, no cloud sync, no uploads, no server
storage, no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription: unlimited essays are
free. It is not an editor: you write in Docs, Word, Notion or on paper and
type the new total here. Works on Android and any modern browser, not only
Apple devices. Export a JSON backup to survive a reinstall or move phones.

- [Home](https://essaypad.try-dabble.com/): The tracker

## Features

- Several essays / projects: create, rename, edit target and deadline, delete
- Target word count (required) and optional, clearable deadline
- "Update words": enter the new absolute total; optional date (defaults to today) to back-date; optional note
- Progress bar with percent and words to go; "Target reached" when done
- Over-limit warning when the count passes 110% of the target
- Daily target = remaining words ÷ write days from today through the deadline; overdue and catch-up messaging past the deadline
- Write-days toggle: all calendar days, or weekdays only (Saturday and Sunday skipped)
- Per-day history: month calendar with the words added each day plus a list of totals and changes; entries can be deleted
- JSON export / import (`{ app: "essaypad", version: 1, essays, prefs }`; also accepts a bare array or alternate key names)
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
